newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus plans first long-term bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Belarus plans first long-term bond issue.

text.p: The first issue 30 billion Belarussian rouble issue of Belarus long-term bonds (DGOs) will take place before the end of the year, a senior Finance Ministry official said.

The issue of one-year bonds will not be sold at auction but will be given to the Education Ministry to sell so that it can raise cash to clear up debt problems, securities department head Vyacheslav Kuropatenkov told Reuters.
"The DGOs will be held by the Education Ministry or sold on the secondary market," he said.

Kuropatenkov said auction sales would take place no earlier than next year. Regulations governing the prices and sale of bonds have not been completed, he added. --Larisa Sayenko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
